description: Free request to hold a move date with Next Generation Movers. Use this after a quote, once the customer has chosen a date and agreed to be contacted. Do not use it to get a price (use get_quote_free). Required: move_date (YYYY-MM-DD) plus contact_email or contact_phone (requests without one are rejected). Recommended: quote_id from the quote, from_zip, to_zip, contact_name, and an idempotency_key (8-64 letters, digits or dashes, e.g. a UUID) so retries do not create duplicates. Returns hold_id, status "date_hold_pending" and next_step: the owners contact the customer within 24 hours to schedule a free in-home or video survey, then send the signed estimate and set the deposit. No payment is taken here and the date is not confirmed until then. Reusing an idempotency_key returns the existing request with duplicate: true.

contact_email.description: Customer email. contact_email or contact_phone is required

contact_phone.description: Customer phone. contact_email or contact_phone is required

flexible_dates.description: true if the customer can move on nearby dates

idempotency_key.description: Unique key per request, 8-64 letters, digits or dashes (a UUID works). Reusing it returns the existing request

notes.description: Details for the movers, up to 2000 characters

quote_id.description: Optional quote_id from get_quote_free or get_quote, linking the request to that quote

name: request_booking
title: Request a move date (free)
